## Schema

### Optional

- `float32_oneof_request` (Number) float32 oneOf request only maximums (union of 1.1 and 2.2)
- `float32_oneof_request_and_response` (Number) float32 oneOf request and response maximums (union of 1.1 and 2.2)
- `float32_oneof_response` (Number) float32 oneOf response only maximums (union of 1.1 and 2.2)
- `float32_request` (Number) float32 request only maximum (1.1)
- `float32_request_and_response` (Number) float32 request and response maximum (both 12.12)
- `float32_response` (Number) float32 response only maximum (2.2)
- `float32_with_minimum` (Number) float32 request and response minimum (both 11.11) and maximum (both 12.12)
- `float64_oneof_request` (Number) float64 oneOf request only maximums (union of 1.1 and 2.2)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_maximum.my_testing_oas_maximum
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_maximum.my_testing_oas_maximum "..."
```
